source: MSC Datamart GDPS 15 km global regular lat-lon GRIB2 product
time_policy: GDPS publishes its invariant surface identities in the analysis (PT000H) files only; terrain is decoded there, proven invariant across every supplied time, and bound to all primary valid times by the composition's cycle_invariant_broadcast alignment. The land mask and ice analysis ride the primary inputs the same way, as cycle_invariant mapped fields.
member_policy: GDPS is deterministic; no member identity exists
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
